name: tags-passed-over-at-depth
reference: spec/engine-spec.md Version 0.28 (the cbor wire): Tags: every tag on an item a line reads or walks into is passed over and not written: 55799 on the top map, 6 on the when value at 0 (the when still holds), 32 on uid, 100 in a one-byte head on probe.a, 100 in a two-byte head on map 7, 1 on the T at 8.[1], 1 on the group array, 65535 on its item; residue keeps its tag: 10 holds c105 and is written c105. Derived without an engine by a standalone RFC 8949 codec.
